queries_run: Qualcomm credit rating 2026 Moody's S&P Apple Samsung customer concentration

findings.claim: FY2026 10-K：Apple 與 Samsung 各占合併營收 10% 以上；少數客戶/授權對象歷來占營收大部分。
findings.excerpt: A small number of customers/licensees historically have accounted for a significant portion of our consolidated revenues. In fiscal 2026, revenues from Apple and Samsung each comprised 10% or more of our consolidated revenues.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：公司預期 Apple 未來主要使用自研數據機，對 QCT 營收、損益與現金流有重大負面影響；Samsung、小米亦自研晶片。
findings.excerpt: we expect that Apple will primarily use its own internally developed modem products, rather than our products, in its devices going forward, which will have a significant negative impact on our QCT revenues, results of operations and cash flows.

findings.claim: Moody's 確認 Qualcomm A2 發行人與優先無擔保債評等、展望穩定（發布日未核）。

customer_concentration_credit.note: 客戶自身信用惡化、破產、降評或下修指引：搜尋未找到相關來源（Moody's A2 穩定展望的結果未顯示日期，未採用）。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
